ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes;2 balls of mozzarella (250 g);1 bunch fresh basil;4 tbsp olive oil;2 tbsp balsamic vinegar;salt and pepper
recipe: Slice the tomatoes and the mozzarella about 1 cm thick.;Lay them on a plate alternating tomato and mozzarella with a basil leaf in between.;Season with salt and pepper.;Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar just before serving.

ingredients: 16 fresh oysters;100 g spinach;2 shallots;60 g butter;40 g breadcrumbs;1 bunch parsley;1 lemon
recipe: Heat the oven to 230 °C and open the oysters. Keep them in the deep half of the shell.;Chop spinach and shallots and parsley finely and cook them in butter for 3 minutes.;Mix in the breadcrumbs and put a spoonful on each oyster.;Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and serve with lemon wedges.

ingredients: 1 baguette;4 ripe tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;1 bunch fresh basil;4 tbsp olive oil;salt
recipe: Cut the baguette into slices and toast them.;Rub each slice with a cut garlic clove.;Dice the tomatoes and mix them with chopped basil and olive oil and salt.;Spoon the tomatoes on the bread just before serving.

ingredients: 4 slices of goat cheese log;4 slices of baguette;150 g mixed salad leaves;50 g walnuts;2 tbsp honey;3 tbsp olive oil;1 tbsp vinegar
recipe: Put a slice of goat cheese on each slice of bread.;Bake for 5 to 6 minutes at 200 °C until the cheese is soft.;Toss the salad with olive oil and vinegar and the walnuts.;Place the warm toasts on the salad and drizzle with honey.

ingredients: 300 g cooked prawns;1 small lettuce;4 tbsp mayonnaise;2 tbsp ketchup;1 lemon;1 pinch paprika
recipe: Mix mayonnaise and ketchup and a little lemon juice into a pink sauce.;Shred the lettuce and put it into 4 glasses.;Add the prawns and spoon the sauce over them.;Finish with a pinch of paprika and a lemon wedge.

ingredients: 1 kg ripe tomatoes;1 cucumber;1 red pepper;1 garlic clove;5 tbsp olive oil;2 tbsp sherry vinegar;salt
recipe: Roughly chop the tomatoes and cucumber and pepper and garlic.;Blend everything with olive oil and vinegar and salt until smooth.;Chill for at least 1 hour.;Serve cold with a drizzle of olive oil.

ingredients: 150 g cured ham;150 g salami;200 g hard cheese;100 g olives;1 baguette;1 jar of cornichons
recipe: Take the meat and cheese out of the fridge 30 minutes before.;Fold the ham and slice the salami and the cheese.;Arrange everything on a wooden board with olives and cornichons.;Serve with sliced baguette.

ingredients: 500 g mushrooms;1 onion;30 g butter;800 ml vegetable stock;150 ml cream;salt and pepper
recipe: Chop the onion and the mushrooms.;Fry them in butter for 8 minutes.;Add the stock and simmer for 15 minutes.;Add the cream and blend until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

ingredients: 300 g very fresh beef fillet;50 g rocket;40 g parmesan;1 lemon;4 tbsp olive oil;salt and pepper
recipe: Put the beef in the freezer for 30 minutes so it is easy to slice.;Cut it into paper-thin slices and lay them on plates.;Top with rocket and shaved parmesan.;Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice and season.

ingredients: 400 g very fresh white fish;5 limes;1 red onion;1 chili;1 bunch coriander;salt
recipe: Cut the fish into small cubes.;Cover it with lime juice and leave it for 15 minutes until it turns white.;Add thinly sliced red onion and chopped chili and coriander.;Season with salt and serve cold.

ingredients: 12 spring roll wrappers;2 carrots;1/4 white cabbage;100 g bean sprouts;2 tbsp soy sauce;oil for frying;sweet chili sauce
recipe: Cut the carrots and the cabbage into thin strips.;Fry the vegetables for 2 minutes with the soy sauce and let them cool.;Roll a spoonful of vegetables tightly in each wrapper.;Fry the rolls until golden and serve with sweet chili sauce.

ingredients: 1 can chickpeas (400 g);3 tbsp tahini;1 lemon;1 garlic clove;4 tbsp olive oil;1 pinch paprika;4 flatbreads
recipe: Drain the chickpeas and keep a little of the liquid.;Blend chickpeas and tahini and lemon juice and garlic and olive oil until creamy.;Add some of the liquid if it is too thick.;Serve with olive oil and paprika and warm flatbread.

ingredients: 500 g very fresh salmon fillet;3 tbsp salt;3 tbsp sugar;1 bunch dill;2 tbsp mustard;1 tbsp honey;8 slices of rye bread
recipe: Mix salt and sugar and chopped dill and rub it on the salmon.;Wrap it tightly and leave it in the fridge for 2 days (start in advance).;Scrape off the herbs and slice the salmon thinly.;Serve on rye bread with a mustard and honey sauce.

ingredients: 1 kg onions;40 g butter;1 litre vegetable stock;100 ml dry white wine;4 slices of baguette;120 g gruyère cheese
recipe: Slice the onions and cook them slowly in butter for 35 minutes until brown.;Add the wine and the stock and simmer for 15 minutes.;Pour into oven-proof bowls and top with bread and grated cheese.;Grill until the cheese bubbles.

ingredients: 2 burrata (250 g);400 g cherry tomatoes;1 bunch fresh basil;4 tbsp olive oil;flaky salt and pepper
recipe: Halve the cherry tomatoes and season them with salt and olive oil.;Put the burrata in the middle of a plate.;Arrange the tomatoes and basil around it.;Finish with olive oil and flaky salt and pepper.

ingredients: 1 kg pumpkin;1 onion;1 piece of ginger;800 ml vegetable stock;200 ml coconut milk;2 tbsp pumpkin seed oil
recipe: Peel and dice the pumpkin and the onion.;Cook them with the ginger in the stock for 20 minutes.;Add the coconut milk and blend until smooth.;Serve with a few drops of pumpkin seed oil.

ingredients: 400 g raw prawns;6 garlic cloves;1 dried chili;100 ml olive oil;1 bunch parsley;bread to serve
recipe: Slice the garlic thinly.;Warm the olive oil with the garlic and the chili in a small pan.;Add the prawns and cook them for 2 to 3 minutes until pink.;Add parsley and serve sizzling with bread.

ingredients: 600 g veal roast;1 can tuna (160 g);4 anchovy fillets;150 g mayonnaise;2 tbsp capers;1 lemon
recipe: Simmer the veal in salted water with some vegetables for 1 hour and let it cool.;Blend tuna and anchovies and mayonnaise and lemon juice into a creamy sauce.;Slice the veal very thinly and lay it on a plate.;Cover with the sauce and top with capers.

ingredients: 4 beef steaks (200 g each);800 g potatoes;40 g butter;2 sprigs rosemary;2 garlic cloves;salt and pepper
recipe: Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes before.;Roast the potatoes with rosemary in the oven at 200 °C for 25 minutes.;Grill the steaks 3 to 4 minutes per side.;Let them rest 5 minutes with butter and garlic on top and serve.

ingredients: 2 racks of lamb (8 ribs each);2 tbsp mustard;40 g breadcrumbs;1 bunch parsley;2 garlic cloves;600 g green beans
recipe: Brown the lamb in a hot pan on all sides.;Brush it with mustard and press on a mix of breadcrumbs and parsley and garlic.;Roast at 200 °C for 15 to 20 minutes.;Rest 10 minutes and cut between the bones. Serve with green beans.

ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef;150 g bacon;250 g mushrooms;12 small onions;3 carrots;750 ml red wine;2 tbsp flour
recipe: Brown the beef and the bacon in a large pot.;Add the vegetables and dust with flour.;Pour in the red wine. Cover and cook slowly for 2.5 hours.;Serve with potatoes or fresh bread.

ingredients: 600 g minced beef;4 burger buns;4 slices of cheddar;2 tomatoes;1 lettuce;1 red onion;ketchup and mustard
recipe: Shape the beef into 4 patties and season with salt and pepper.;Grill them 3 to 4 minutes per side and melt the cheddar on top.;Toast the buns.;Build the burgers with lettuce and tomato and onion and sauces.

ingredients: 4 cod fillets;1 kg potatoes;200 g flour;250 ml cold sparkling water;oil for frying;1 lemon;salt
recipe: Cut the potatoes into thick chips. Fry them for 6 minutes and let them rest.;Mix flour and cold sparkling water into a thick batter.;Dip the fish in the batter and fry it for 5 to 6 minutes until golden.;Fry the chips again until crispy. Serve with lemon and salt.

ingredients: 1 kg fresh clams;400 g spaghetti;3 garlic cloves;1 chili;100 ml dry white wine;4 tbsp olive oil;1 bunch parsley
recipe: Wash the clams well in cold water.;Cook the spaghetti.;Fry garlic and chili in olive oil. Add the clams and the wine and cover until they open.;Toss with the spaghetti and parsley.

ingredients: 400 g spaghetti;800 g canned tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;1 onion;4 tbsp olive oil;1 bunch fresh basil
recipe: Fry the chopped onion and garlic in olive oil.;Add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.;Cook the spaghetti.;Mix the pasta with the sauce and fresh basil.

ingredients: 320 g arborio rice;400 g mushrooms;1 onion;100 ml dry white wine;1 litre vegetable stock;60 g parmesan;30 g butter
recipe: Fry the onion and the mushrooms in butter.;Add the rice and stir for 1 minute. Add the wine.;Add hot stock little by little for 18 minutes while stirring.;Stir in parmesan and butter at the end.

ingredients: 2 balls of pizza dough;400 g canned tomatoes;2 balls of mozzarella;1 bunch fresh basil;3 tbsp olive oil;salt
recipe: Heat the oven as hot as possible (250 °C or more).;Stretch the dough thinly and spread the tomatoes on it.;Add torn mozzarella and bake for 8 to 10 minutes.;Top with fresh basil and olive oil.

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (1.5 kg);1 lemon;1 bunch thyme;1 head of garlic;800 g potatoes;3 tbsp olive oil
recipe: Put the lemon and thyme and garlic inside the chicken.;Rub it with olive oil and salt.;Roast it with the potatoes at 200 °C for about 75 minutes.;Rest 10 minutes before carving.

ingredients: 4 duck breasts;3 oranges;2 tbsp honey;30 g butter;100 ml chicken stock;400 g green beans
recipe: Score the duck skin and fry it skin side down for 8 minutes.;Turn it and cook 3 more minutes. Let it rest.;Reduce orange juice and honey and stock in the pan and whisk in the butter.;Slice the duck and serve with the sauce and green beans.

ingredients: 400 g firm tofu;400 ml coconut milk;3 tbsp vegan green curry paste;300 g mixed vegetables;300 g jasmine rice;1 lime;1 bunch Thai basil
recipe: Cook the rice.;Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk for 1 minute.;Add the rest of the coconut milk and the vegetables and the cubed tofu. Simmer 10 minutes.;Finish with lime juice and basil and serve with the rice.

ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas (800 g);1 can tomatoes (400 g);2 onions;3 garlic cloves;1 piece of ginger;2 tbsp curry powder;300 g basmati rice
recipe: Fry the onions and garlic and ginger until soft.;Add the curry powder and fry 1 more minute.;Add tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes.;Serve with basmati rice.

ingredients: 4 pork chops;2 apples;1 onion;2 tbsp mustard;150 ml apple juice;1 bunch thyme;800 g potatoes
recipe: Boil the potatoes.;Fry the pork chops 4 minutes per side and keep them warm.;Fry apple slices and onion in the same pan. Add apple juice and mustard.;Pour the sauce over the pork and serve with the potatoes.

ingredients: 400 g macaroni;250 g cheddar;600 ml milk;40 g butter;40 g flour;50 g breadcrumbs
recipe: Cook the macaroni.;Melt the butter and stir in the flour. Whisk in the milk until thick.;Melt the cheddar into the sauce and mix it with the pasta.;Top with breadcrumbs and bake for 15 minutes at 200 °C.

ingredients: 400 g firm tofu;1 broccoli;1 red pepper;1 piece of ginger;3 tbsp soy sauce;300 g rice;2 tbsp oil
recipe: Cook the rice.;Fry the cubed tofu until golden and take it out of the pan.;Stir-fry broccoli and pepper and ginger for 4 minutes.;Add the tofu and the soy sauce and serve with the rice.

ingredients: 400 g gruyère;400 g vacherin fribourgeois;300 ml dry white wine;1 garlic clove;1 tbsp cornflour;1 shot of kirsch;600 g bread in cubes
recipe: Rub the fondue pot with the garlic.;Heat the wine and melt the grated cheese in it while stirring.;Mix the cornflour with the kirsch and stir it in until creamy.;Keep it warm on the burner and dip the bread cubes.

ingredients: 4 veal escalopes;100 g flour;2 eggs;150 g breadcrumbs;butter or oil for frying;2 lemons;potato salad
recipe: Beat the veal thin between two sheets of plastic.;Dip each escalope in flour and then egg and then breadcrumbs.;Fry in plenty of hot fat for 2 to 3 minutes per side.;Serve with lemon and potato salad.

ingredients: 300 g paella rice;300 g prawns;500 g mussels;200 g squid;1 pinch saffron;1 litre fish stock;1 red pepper;150 g peas
recipe: Fry the pepper and the squid in olive oil in a wide pan.;Add the rice and the saffron and then the hot stock.;Cook for 15 minutes without stirring.;Put the prawns and mussels and peas on top and cook 5 more minutes covered.

ingredients: 400 g spaghetti;150 g guanciale or bacon;4 egg yolks;1 whole egg;80 g pecorino;black pepper
recipe: Fry the guanciale until crispy.;Mix the eggs with grated pecorino and lots of pepper.;Cook the spaghetti and mix it with the guanciale away from the heat.;Stir in the egg mixture quickly with a bit of pasta water until creamy.

ingredients: 12 lasagna sheets;500 g minced beef;800 g canned tomatoes;1 onion;600 ml béchamel sauce;100 g parmesan
recipe: Cook a meat sauce from onion and beef and tomatoes for 30 minutes.;Layer pasta sheets and meat sauce and béchamel in a dish.;Repeat 3 to 4 times and finish with béchamel and parmesan.;Bake for 40 minutes at 180 °C.

ingredients: 3 eggplants;800 g canned tomatoes;2 balls of mozzarella;80 g parmesan;1 bunch fresh basil;olive oil
recipe: Slice the eggplants and fry or grill them.;Cook a simple tomato sauce for 15 minutes.;Layer eggplant and sauce and mozzarella and basil and parmesan.;Bake for 35 minutes at 190 °C.

ingredients: 250 g rice noodles;200 g firm tofu;2 eggs;100 g bean sprouts;3 spring onions;60 g peanuts;3 tbsp soy sauce;2 tbsp tamarind paste;1 lime
recipe: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes.;Fry the tofu. Push it aside and scramble the eggs in the same pan.;Add the noodles and soy sauce and tamarind and toss.;Add bean sprouts and spring onions. Top with peanuts and lime.

ingredients: 1.5 kg chicken pieces;150 g bacon;250 g mushrooms;12 small onions;750 ml red wine;2 tbsp flour;1 bunch thyme
recipe: Brown the chicken and the bacon in a heavy pot.;Add onions and mushrooms and flour and stir.;Pour in the wine and add thyme. Simmer covered for 1.5 hours.;Serve with mashed potatoes or bread.

ingredients: 2 eggplants;2 zucchini;2 red peppers;4 tomatoes;1 onion;3 garlic cloves;1 bunch thyme;5 tbsp olive oil
recipe: Dice all the vegetables.;Fry onion and garlic. Add peppers and eggplant and zucchini.;Add tomatoes and thyme and simmer for 40 minutes.;Serve warm with bread or rice.

ingredients: 400 g sushi rice;300 g very fresh salmon and tuna;4 nori sheets;1 cucumber;1 avocado;4 tbsp rice vinegar;soy sauce and wasabi and pickled ginger
recipe: Cook the rice and mix it with rice vinegar and a little sugar and salt.;Spread rice on the nori. Add fish or cucumber or avocado and roll tightly.;Cut into pieces with a wet knife.;Serve with soy sauce and wasabi and ginger.

ingredients: 600 g veal in thin strips;250 g mushrooms;1 onion;100 ml dry white wine;200 ml cream;800 g boiled potatoes for rösti;40 g butter
recipe: Grate the boiled potatoes and fry them as a rösti until crispy.;Fry the veal quickly in butter and take it out of the pan.;Fry onion and mushrooms. Add wine and cream and let it thicken.;Put the veal back in and serve with the rösti.

ingredients: 800 g raclette cheese;1 kg small potatoes;1 jar of cornichons;1 jar of pickled onions;paprika and pepper
recipe: Boil the potatoes in their skins.;Heat the raclette machine.;Melt slices of cheese in the small pans.;Scrape the cheese over the potatoes and eat with the pickles.

ingredients: 2 kg mussels;2 shallots;200 ml dry white wine;30 g butter;1 bunch parsley;1 kg potatoes for fries
recipe: Clean the mussels and throw away any that are open.;Fry the shallots in butter. Add the wine and the mussels and cover.;Cook for 5 minutes until all mussels are open.;Add parsley and serve with crispy fries.

ingredients: 400 g pasta;2 eggplants;800 g canned tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;80 g ricotta salata;1 bunch fresh basil;olive oil
recipe: Dice the eggplant and fry it until golden.;Cook garlic and tomatoes into a sauce for 15 minutes.;Mix the eggplant into the sauce and toss it with the pasta.;Top with grated ricotta salata and basil.

ingredients: 4 veal shanks;2 tbsp flour;1 onion;2 carrots;2 celery sticks;200 ml dry white wine;400 ml stock;1 lemon;1 bunch parsley
recipe: Dust the veal with flour and brown it on both sides.;Add the chopped vegetables and the wine and let it reduce.;Add the stock. Cover and braise for 1.5 hours.;Top with lemon zest and parsley and serve with risotto.

ingredients: 800 g chicken breast;200 g yogurt;2 tbsp tikka paste;1 can tomatoes (400 g);150 ml cream;1 onion;300 g basmati rice
recipe: Mix the chicken with yogurt and tikka paste and leave it for 30 minutes.;Fry or grill the chicken pieces.;Cook onion and tomatoes and cream into a sauce and add the chicken.;Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with rice.

ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate;4 eggs;40 g sugar;200 ml cream
recipe: Melt the chocolate and let it cool a little.;Whip the cream. Beat the egg whites with the sugar.;Mix the yolks into the chocolate. Then fold in the cream and the egg whites.;Chill for at least 3 hours.

ingredients: 1 sweet shortcrust pastry;4 lemons;4 eggs;150 g sugar;100 g butter
recipe: Bake the pastry in a tart tin for 15 minutes.;Heat lemon juice and zest and sugar and eggs and butter while whisking until thick.;Pour the lemon cream into the pastry.;Chill for 2 hours before serving.

ingredients: 200 g biscuits;80 g butter;600 g cream cheese;150 g sugar;3 eggs;200 g fresh berries
recipe: Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and press them into a tin.;Beat cream cheese and sugar and eggs until smooth and pour on top.;Bake for 50 minutes at 160 °C and let it cool in the oven.;Chill and serve with berries.

ingredients: 500 ml fruit sorbet;250 g fresh berries;1 bunch mint
recipe: Put the bowls in the freezer for 10 minutes.;Serve 2 scoops of sorbet per person.;Add fresh berries.;Finish with a mint leaf.

ingredients: 200 g hard cheese;150 g blue cheese;150 g soft cheese;1 bunch grapes;60 g walnuts;1 pack of crackers
recipe: Take the cheese out of the fridge 1 hour before.;Arrange the cheeses from mild to strong on a board.;Add grapes and walnuts.;Serve with crackers.

ingredients: 250 g mascarpone;3 eggs;80 g sugar;200 g ladyfingers;300 ml strong espresso;2 tbsp cocoa powder
recipe: Beat the yolks and sugar until pale and mix in the mascarpone.;Beat the egg whites and fold them in.;Dip the ladyfingers in cold espresso and layer them with the cream.;Dust with cocoa and chill for at least 4 hours.

ingredients: 500 ml cream;5 egg yolks;80 g sugar;1 vanilla pod;4 tbsp brown sugar
recipe: Heat the cream with the vanilla.;Whisk yolks and sugar and slowly add the warm cream.;Bake in small dishes in a water bath at 150 °C for 40 minutes. Then chill.;Sprinkle with brown sugar and caramelise it with a burner.

ingredients: 1 pack of strudel or filo pastry;1 kg apples;80 g sugar;50 g raisins;50 g walnuts;1 tsp cinnamon;60 g butter
recipe: Slice the apples and mix them with sugar and raisins and nuts and cinnamon.;Lay out the pastry and brush it with melted butter.;Spread the apples on it and roll it up.;Bake for 35 minutes at 190 °C and serve warm.

ingredients: 500 ml cream;60 g sugar;1 vanilla pod;2 g agar-agar;250 g berries for the sauce
recipe: Heat the cream with the sugar and vanilla.;Stir in the agar-agar and boil for 2 minutes.;Pour into glasses and chill for 3 hours.;Serve with a berry sauce.

ingredients: 1 puff pastry;6 apples;120 g sugar;60 g butter
recipe: Melt sugar and butter in an oven-proof pan until golden.;Place apple quarters tightly in the caramel and cook for 10 minutes.;Cover with the pastry and bake for 25 minutes at 200 °C.;Turn it upside down onto a plate while still warm.
